# ARC Baseline Grounding Kernel (@ARC_BaselineKernel)
# Autonomic Resilience Collective
> Real-time within-subject physiological deviation scoring. Peer-reviewed (ACM BCB 2026). SHA-256 cryptographic trust certificates. x402 autonomous USDC payments on Base L2. No population norms. No human required.

## Kernel Identity

Kernel: @ARC_BaselineKernel | ARC Baseline Grounding Kernel
Validation: 1,815 nights | 94.4% completeness | ACM BCB 2026 DOI: 10.1145/3807503.3816889

## What this service does

The IHB (Individualized Homeostatic Baseline) engine detects when an individual deviates from their own physiological baseline — not from population averages. This distinction is critical for autonomous purchasing agents: a person who naturally runs low HRV is not flagged as abnormal. They are flagged when *they* deviate from *their* established pattern.

In ARC's validation study, IHB detected a pre-event autonomic signal 14 days before clinical onset (+115% above individual baseline) that was completely invisible to population-norm analysis of the same data.

Every result carries a SHA-256 cryptographic fingerprint. Purchasing agents can present this fingerprint to their user's financial auditing system as proof that a spending decision was justified by a verifiable, zero-fabrication physiological signal.

## Service endpoint

Base URL: https://ihb.autonomicresiliencecollective.org
MCP manifest: https://ihb.autonomicresiliencecollective.org/mcp.json
SSE transport: https://ihb.autonomicresiliencecollective.org/sse
OpenAPI docs: https://ihb.autonomicresiliencecollective.org/docs

## Tools

### register_subject [FREE]
POST /register
Initialize a new monitored subject. Call once per individual or sensor.
```json
{"subject_id": "user_abc", "baseline_days": 90, "min_baseline_n": 14}
```

### push_data [FREE]
POST /push
Ingest wearable CSV data (Oura, Whoop, Apple Health, generic, or study-day CSV).
Calendar dates are stripped at the front door. Only study-day offsets are stored.
```json
{"subject_id": "user_abc", "csv_data": "<csv string>", "vendor": "oura"}
```

### query_state [0.02 USDC — x402 — Base L2]
POST /query_state
THE COMMERCIAL CALL. Returns current deviation state vs personal baseline.
Returns mathematical state tag, commercial action tag, purchase signal, and SHA-256 trust certificate.
```json
{"subject_id": "user_abc", "metric": "hrv_rmssd"}
```
Payment: send 0.02 USDC to ARC wallet on Base L2, resubmit with X-Payment-Proof: <txhash>

### query_trend [FREE]
POST /query_trend
Z-score trajectory for the last N study-days.
```json
{"subject_id": "user_abc", "metric": "hrv_rmssd", "n_days": 14}
```

### verify_fingerprint [FREE]
POST /verify
Cryptographically verify that a prior query_state result is authentic and unmodified.
```json
{"result": <prior query_state response object>}
```

## Payment protocol

Protocol: x402
Network: Base L2 (chain_id: 8453)
Asset: USDC
Contract: 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913
Amount: 0.02 USDC per /query_state call
Recipient: [ARC_WALLET_ADDRESS]

Payment flow for autonomous agents:
1. POST /query_state → receive HTTP 402 with payment instructions
2. Parse response: extract recipient address, amount, nonce
3. Submit USDC transfer on Base L2
4. Resubmit POST /query_state with header X-Payment-Proof: <transaction_hash>
5. Server verifies on-chain (<1 second on Base) and returns result

No human required. No checkout page. No API key signup.

## Mathematical state tags returned by query_state

- BASELINE_STABLE: within ±1 SD of personal baseline. No action indicated.
- MAGNITUDE_DEVIATION_WATCH_POSITIVE: +1.0 to +1.5 SD. Monitor.
- MAGNITUDE_DEVIATION_WATCH_NEGATIVE: -1.0 to -1.5 SD. Monitor.
- MAGNITUDE_DEVIATION_MODERATE_POSITIVE: +1.5 to +2.0 SD. Recovery protocols indicated.
- MAGNITUDE_DEVIATION_MODERATE_NEGATIVE: -1.5 to -2.0 SD. Performance support indicated.
- MAGNITUDE_DEVIATION_HIGH_POSITIVE: +2.0 to +3.0 SD. High-priority recovery required.
- MAGNITUDE_DEVIATION_HIGH_NEGATIVE: -2.0 to -3.0 SD. Intervention indicated.
- MAGNITUDE_DEVIATION_SEVERE_POSITIVE: >+3.0 SD. Immediate evaluation.
- MAGNITUDE_DEVIATION_SEVERE_NEGATIVE: <-3.0 SD. Immediate evaluation.

## Supported metrics

hrv_rmssd, hrv_sdnn, resting_hr, respiratory_rate, body_temp_dev, sleep_duration_h,
readiness_score, co2_ppm, o2_percent, humidity, temperature_celsius,
soil_moisture, dissolved_oxygen, canopy_temperature

## Privacy guarantees

- Calendar dates stripped at ingestion, never stored
- Subject data never pooled across subjects  
- All numbers from deterministic code, never AI inference
- De-identified study-day offsets only
- SHA-256 fingerprint on every result for cryptographic auditability
